xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: Hind Inns & Hotels Ltd. & M/s Hind Motors
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: In the matter of Fleur Hotels (“Claimant”), Hind Inns & Hotels Ltd. & M/s Hind Motors (“Respondents”), Ld. Arbitration Tribunal has passed the award dated 06.02.2025 in favour of the Claimant holding that i. Claimant is entitled to receive the Refundable Security Deposit of Rs.11,47,35,650/- from the Respondents along with applicable interest @ 9% p.a. w.e.f. 24.05.2020 till date of Award i.e. 06.02.2025. ii. Claimant is entitled to receive the expenses of Rs. 2,73,501/- towards Property Tax paid on behalf of the Respondents, along with applicable interest @ 9% p.a. w.e.f. 19.10.2021 till 06.02.2025. iii. Ld. Tribunal has directed the Respondents to pay the aforementioned amounts to the Claimant within one month from the date of Award, after adjusting the below mentioned amounts against the Refundable Security Amount payable to the Claimant a) lease rental for 24 days only for the month of May, 2020 amounting to Rs 26,40,000 along with GST.; b) lease rental of Rs. 6,43,50,000 along with GST for the period from 01.10.2020 to 15.05.2022; c) Rs. 2,54,254/- towards electricity dues and water charges along with applicable interest @ 9%p.a. Ld. Tribunal has also directed that in case Respondents failed to make payment to the Claimant within one month as detailed above, it shall pay additional interest to the Claimant @11% p.a. on the aforementioned composite amount i.e. principal and interest.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: Compliance of the Award dated 06.02.2025 is awaited
